newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish parliament ratifies OECD entry.
newsitem.headline: Polish parliament ratifies OECD entry.

text.p: Poland's lower house of parliament on Friday ratified the country's membership agreement with the Organisation of Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD).
The house overwhelmingly approved two bills, empowering President Aleksander Kwasniewski to sign the 1960 OECD convention and another on relations between the Polish government and the OECD.
The bills passed 356 to 14 with three abstentions and 353 to 16 with five abstentions respectively. They will have to clear the senate and be signed by the president, which is a formality.
Poland was accepted into the OECD, the Paris-based club of 27 most developed nations, in July as the third former Soviet bloc country after the Czech Republic and Hungary.
It sees the membership as an important step on its way to the European Union.
